excerpt.zh: 这是我们的第一个系外£colony£殖民地！这样就算母星发生爆炸，也不用担心面临消灭的命运了！还不赖吧？
excerpt.en: Our first extrasolar £colony£ Colony! This means that if our homeworld were to spontaneously combust, your species would no longer be rendered extinct. That is a comforting thought, wouldn't you say?
